title: armeria maritima subsp. californica
intro: Armeria maritima subsp. californica, commonly known as California Sea Thrift or Californian Sea Thrift, is a subspecies of the sea thrift plant native to the coastal regions of California. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, coughs, and digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Armeria maritima subsp. californica include its expectorant properties, which help to relieve congestion and coughs, and its anti-inflammatory properties, which aid in reducing swelling and pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
